reviews.text: I have used Paxton for many years, they are such a lovely team. It’s a personal service which is always appreciated. I would like to just take a minute to do a huge, massive, shoutout to the amazing Vet nurse who did my cats vet check yesterday. She was so kind and caring, really listened and took her time and had great knowledge of my breed of cat, which is a Peterbald so quite rare. The cats also had a wonderful experience, nothing was too much trouble and I felt really listened too.

I’m extremely disappointed with the way Nat treated my wife. Her attitude was unacceptable and completely unprofessional. Because my wife was just 9 minutes late, Nat told her the cat would have to sit in a carrier for 2 hours until the next appointment. Why should an animal be punished because its owner is late? What if this had been a seriously sick animal needing urgent attention?

This has left us both deeply worried about our cat being in their care today. After reading your other one-star reviews, it seems complaints about your reception team are a recurring issue. Perhaps it’s time to retrain the reception staff or consider replacing them. Pet owners deserve to be treated with respect, and animals deserve kindness and compassion. I hope management takes this seriously and investigates Nat’s behaviour

⭐ Had a horrible experience with a receptionist called Nat. I rang to explain I was running late, and she was rude from the very beginning, even calling me a liar. I understand being late is inconvenient, but there’s no excuse for that attitude.

I’ve had to leave my frightened cat there for the day, and I’m deeply worried about her being in their care after that phone call. My cat is still a baby herself and has already had two litters, and I’m simply trying to do the right thing by getting her spayed ASAP.

A vet receptionist should show compassion to both pets and owners. Nat’s behaviour was completely unprofessional and has left me seriously concerned about my cat’s welfare. If anything were to happen to my cat today, I would expect a full investigation into the circumstances, including Nat’s conduct. She showed me absolutely no compassion or reassurance that she genuinely cares about animals I was 9 mins late by the way
Great staff, always very helpful and knowledgeable, friendly cat
My experience at a recent visit was excellent. The staff at reception are always lovely and the vet was thorough, took her time with my dog and explained the treatments available and next steps.
Disgusting service received - vets are non-professional - do not care about animals - have no compassion or empathy.  All about the money.  Avoid at all costs.
We saw Amber today and she was lovely to my 14 year old Chelsea girl!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Well knowledgeable friendly staff.

All members of staff are friendly and polite.
But when it comes to the vets I prefer to see Pru when I visit with my rescue kittens. I feel she understands my concerns and will explain what I can do to help them.

A big thank you to the Paxton team for looking after our cat this July after she swallowed a sewing thread and ended up needing emergency abdominal surgery, one of those things you never imagine happening until it does!
A special thank you to Sally for always being so kind and welcoming at reception, to Louisa, for reassuring me and helping with the insurance side of things, and to Joseph and Daniela for taking such good care of her before and after surgery.
It ended up being quite an ordeal (and a costly one, even with insurance!), but we are very grateful for all the kindness and support we received along the way. Thankfully, our cat has recovered really well and is back to herself again. Thank you! Karine & family ❤️
Paxton vets are always helpful and will try to fit you in at short notice if needed. It’s a calming environment for your pets.
Really happy with Paxton vets, all my fur friends have been looked after there. They are a friendly team and always happy to answer questions and give tips on looking after them.
The staff were, as always helpful and charming, they made the whole experience,as well as payment, easy.
Paxton Vets have been looking after my cat for 10 years now. Wonderful team, appointments are easy to book, very friendly atmosphere. Dr. Cat is great 🌟

Always helpful, usually
have appointments available,  very good in emergencies. Highly recommend

Sadly our kitten Arthur became very unwell very quickly, having frequent seizures with no clear cause. From the very beginning, Vet Joe Haskins cared for Arthur with constant compassion, professionalism and kindness.
Joe kept an open line of communication with us throughout Arthur’s care and always took the time to explain everything clearly and answer all of our many questions. We always felt that Arthur was receiving the very best care and during such an emotional and uncertain time Joe’s input and expertise was invaluable to us.
We are so grateful to Joe and the team for the genuine compassion showed not only to Arthur but also to us.

I've been going to Paxtons for many years while fostering/adopting greyhounds. The whole team here are so friendly, welcoming, and incredibly caring with my dogs. They really understand the unique needs of greyhounds, which gives me complete confidence in the care they provide.

The vets always take the time to explain the diagnosis clearly, discuss the available treatment options, and ensure I fully understand any medication that has been prescribed. The care and compassion shown by everyone at the practice are exceptional, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Paxtons to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and trustworthy veterinary practice.
Very unhelpful
Dr. Haskins was so good with my cat. Buddy had special needs, he has FeLV+. This doctors was so nice and especially kind and very cute.  spider handsome
Lovely team know how really look after you and your pet. I have being using this vet for 30 years and I wouldn't go anywhere else
The team at Paxton Vets have been wonderful. They are caring, professional and always take the time to explain things clearly. I feel confident that Billie is receiving excellent care.

Paxtons vets have always been so kind and sensitive when dealing with our queries and when looking after our beloved cat. A big shout out to all the staff, admin, managerial and clinical.  A brilliant team all round, I couldn't recommend them more highly
Very helpful Thank you

Avoid at any cost. The most expensive vet in the area. To call their pricing dishonest is an understatement. Even if you have to take taxi to go elsewhere it will be worth it - still much, much cheaper - for real, I checked!
I booked my cat for a health check at Paxton Veterinary Clinic Dulwich (231 Gipsy Rd, Norwood) - consultation cost £65 (this is a normal/average price for a vet consultation in the area). The consultation took a whole 6 minutes just to find out what I already knew from Google... fair enough. Of course before treatment can be prescribed you must do a blood test - understandable. The blood test price, behold - £240 only! Really?
I called at least 3 other vet clinics in the area - prices for the same bood test range from £120 to £200. But if you go to Paxton Veterinary Clinic Dulwich it will cost you £240 (+ £65 consultation fee). Shameful!
And just in case you wondered, it's a regular clinic, no spa or free drinks offered.

Paxton vets have cared for both my dogs for over 10 years. I find all the support team to be very friendly and helpful. Vet Joseph has been brilliant at explaining care options for our dog while she has been sick, he ensures that I understand options, costs and how we can best look after her. I high recommend this vets.
Very friendly, explain everything that there going to do and what the side effects will be and make sure that your are comfortable with it
Always really helpful, kind and understanding. Alfie is very loved at this clinic and the staff always give him time and attention. As a dog owner I always feel calm and supported.
Paxton Green is without doubt the best of vets - top professional care and warm welcome every time.
Very caring Vet, Jo. Also very thorough. Expensive because cat needed blood tests.

Hi Debora

Thank you for your five star review

From us all at Paxton Vets

As always, friendly, helpful and approachable reception desk staff.
I was impressed by vet Anna’s thorough examination and recommended treatment plan. She was very gentle when examining my dog’s painful and infected ear canal.
Anna also listened carefully and offered good advice about my worries regarding Maia’s eating/drinking and regurgitation and possible sensitivity to certain foods.
Came as a recommendation from a cat sitter. We find Paxtons to have friendly staff who are helpful efficient.

My first time owning a pet. Unfortunately they do not disclose hidden fees and I have never and I mean NEVER faced such rudeness from a receptionist in my life when I was hit with an unexpected fee of over £130. Louisa pretty much threatened me via phone and text. No professionalism or consideration considering they withhold necessary fee information beforehand. Some staff are great but overall- I will not forget how I was spoken to. I prefer to travel with my pet than use my local who do not respect their customers. Especially if you’re at all impacted my the cost of living. Very strange advocates for healthcare. Louisa acted more like a bailiff and a bully.

Got an appointment for the same day.  Friendly team, thorough consultation & fab explanations by the vet Joe.
Definitely recommend.
Great vets.
The staff at both Paxton Vet sites are really lovely. From receptionists to nurses to surgeons, every person really loves animals and have taken great care of my old tribe.
always helpful and caring. if i need to deal with pet plan my insurers, Paxton always helps me with this. They always go the extra mile  for  me and my cat.
nice vets, friendly and attentive staff

Drove two hours to see Pru who came highly recommended with a disabled 2 year old dog with complex needs. Pru is extremely intelligent
Both a vet and clinical canine behaviourist.
She noticed things we had missed.
Well worth the drive!
If you need a specialist vet for a complicated dog then it's worth travelling to help understand your animal within a holistic manner. Have additional tests and try other medications that may help.
Lovely practice, the receptionist was very helpful and the lovely vet fitted me in even though I had turned up a week early by accident, my mistake!  Would definitely recommend.
Friendly and welcoming. Sadly I found a cat dead by the side of the road and the team immediately helped. A big thank you to them

I took a kitten in poor health condition as an emergency visit. The clinician was an absolute gem, very attentive, very professional and committed to helping that poor little kitten my daughter had found a week ago. The care given was excellent and she was very focused in trying to get to the bottom of the problem which was a rather tricky one.

Paxton have been brilliant with our cat since we got him a few months ago as a rescue. They’ve been attentive and also flexible when we or my parents have had issues taking him in due to transport problems. The receptionists are also kind and responsive and overall we’ve been very pleased with the level of care by the staff there.

This is my local vets and they normally have fantastic receptionists but the woman who answered the phone to do gave off nothing but attitude from her greeting. If that had been my first time contacting the service I would have found another practice.

We have been going to Paxton Vets for a few years now and find them to be very kind and professional. We always seem to find parking available on the street as well. We highly recommend them. Peter and Catherine.
I’ve been going here for 3 years now with my dog - always happy with the care, and reception staff are so helpful and accommodating. Wouldn’t go anywhere else!

First time attending and the male vet (unsure of his name) was very nice, helpful and reassuring.
They were better than my other vet in Addiscombe. Paxton had great customer service.
I like how the animals here are given priority. Staff are friendly, prices are reasonable.
Really lovely friendly vets, & more reasonably priced than some others in the local area.

Excellent, very caring vets.
The staff helped us when our cat got out of her carrier on the busy street on our way in, and successfully retrieved her from under our car, thankfully unharmed.
Thank you so much!!

Our 19 month mini schnauzer recently went in to get spayed. However, the events that followed I wish for no pet owner to go through.

Upon discharge, we were not fully explained the effects of the drug Metacam. 2 days after the operation our dog started projectile vomiting and the following day started having bloody stools. Firstly, they advised to give an anti nausea injection to help with the sickness and also to gain some appetite back and were also advised to stop using metacam & prescribed a new pain relief and also a stronger probiotic.

Following this, I reached out to a number of schnauzer owners to see if a reaction to metacam like this is common. I received over 60+ comments with the same symptoms as to what our dog had, and some with far more worse symptoms leading to organ failure.

Please note, at no point did no vets at this practice make us aware of side effects of this medication. Of course, I have reached to the manager of the vets, to which showed no remorse for what we had gone through with our pooch.

Following a rather nasty phone call with GM to which I quote “dogs get sick!” from a supposed manager of a vet practice!

I am writing this honest review, to make other pet owners aware of the experience we have gone through, as I wish for no one else to.

I highly recommend paxton vets gypsy hill iam a pensioner and vets can be extremely expensive
But the good thing about this one they have a health plan for your animals at a cost of £20.00 a month this in includes all injections,flea treatment, worming and nails cut and this means i can have peace of mind knowing that my cat will be safe going out and not picking up anything

Great practice! Leaving a review because Google wrongly says they are open on Saturdays, they are but it’s alternating! Be careful! I just walked down to pick up an order and they are closed despite Google saying they are open
Warm, professional and caring. Thank you Anna and colleagues for all the care you gave Koji. We thoroughly recommend you and are very grateful E & P Watson
Really lovely local vets with friendly and reassuring staff, thank you!

I have two cats and just recently added a puppy to our family Paxton Vets in Gypsy Hill is one of the most friendliest vets that I have ever encountered. The staff are lovely helpful understanding and would go the extra mile. They don’t only pay attention to you but also to your pet, they create a calm atmosphere so all my pets feel comfortable going to the vets
Another tick for this practice - once again came to my aid with Lilee - thanks to Hannah and Arasi - appreciate everything you did!

Although the cat hates coming here, I don’t mind it. They give very good advice and are very helpful and accommodating of any issues we have. Bonus points for the ginger cat that sits in the office who knows how to shake paw
Excellent care and given full time to explore my concerns for my elderly cat. Thank you.
Arasi is an excellent vet. Incredibly kind and helpful. Very thorough in her examination of our dog. Knows her stuff and inspires confidence in us.
Excellent….. felt very calm and reassured that my dog would be having the best treatment needed
Really friendly staff who will be open and honest. Gentle and caring to both pets and us as owners. Thank you all.
